mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.boardId, a.userId, a.title, a.visitCount, a.replyCount, a.likeCount, a.state, a.createTime, a.updateTime, -- 查询用户表字段并起别名 u.id AS u_id, u.username AS u_username, u.nickname AS u_nickname, u.avatarUrl AS u_avatarUrl, -- 查询版块表字段并起别名 b.id AS b_id, b.name AS b_name FROM t_article a LEFT JOIN t_user u ON a.userId = u.id LEFT JOIN t_board b ON a.boardId = b.id WHERE a.deleteState = 0 ORDER BY a.createTime DESC

SELECT a.*, u.id AS u_id, u.username AS u_username, u.nickname AS u_nickname, u.avatarUrl AS u_avatarUrl, b.id AS b_id, b.name AS b_name FROM t_article a LEFT JOIN t_user u ON a.userId = u.id LEFT JOIN t_board b ON a.boardId = b.id WHERE a.deleteState = 0
AND a.boardId = #{boardId}
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
